page.overview:
What is Ba Sing Se University?

In 296 BG, the zoology department at Ba Sing Se University was headed by Professor Shaw, who procured a collection of shirshus for the university during an expedition.

The professor was written to by Hei-Ran requesting to borrow the animals from the department, ostensibly to be displayed in the Fire Nation as part of a goodwill tour between the two nations, though in reality to track an escaped Avatar Kyoshi.

Included with the letter was an expensive painting of the northern lights on vellum owned by Jianzhu, intended to "butter [the professor] up".

The university, once a great repository of knowledge for the citizens of Ba Sing Se, saw its academic offerings become somewhat tainted after Long Feng's ascent to the post of Grand Secretariat, especially in the areas of current events and political science. Anyone interested in researching the history or relics of the Air Nomads had to keep their interests private, because it was difficult to mention the Air Nomads without speaking of their demise, and all mentions of the war were censored by the government. Professor Ko of the university was interested in obtaining Air Nomad relics to preserve the history of the lost nation, but kept such motivations entirely secret. Despite the negative effects of political repression, it continued to be regarded as a major school of engineering, architecture, and science. During this time, Professor Zei held the position of head of anthropology and taught a class on desert cultures. In spring 100 AG, Team Avatar visited the university, chaperoned by Joo Dee, while attempting to find a kidnapped Appa. The group questioned a student there, asking him if he had seen any sandbenders or nomads in the city, but the young scholar replied in the negative. However, after Sokka questioned him about the Hundred Year War with the Fire Nation, the student became nervous and, at Joo Dee's subtle direction, dodged the question before claiming he was late for class. With their questions unanswered, the team subsequently left the campus.
